claims.text: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden premieres October 6, 2026 in Japan, with a two-cour broadcast planned.
Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden premieres October 6, 2026 on TOKYO MX, MBS and BS Nippon TV. The official site says the anime will run for two consecutive cours.

TOKYO MX begins the series October 6 at 9:25 p.m. JST. MBS and BS Nippon TV also begin October 6 on their respective late-night schedules. ABEMA and d Anime Store receive the earliest domestic streaming window from 9:55 p.m. JST, with U-NEXT and Anime Hodai following October 9 and additional Japanese services from October 12.

An international streaming platform has not been confirmed on the official anime site at the time of this update. AniNextUp will add a global service only after an official distributor or platform announcement.

A legendary warrior who once defeated a god is reincarnated as the frail noble girl Nia Liston. Rather than settling into a quiet second life, Nia continues searching for powerful opponents while also becoming involved in school life and the fantasy world’s “Magic Vision” entertainment business.

KONAMI animation produces the series. Motoki Nakanishi serves as chief director, Haruta Segi as assistant director, Gigaemon Ichikawa handles series composition, and Yuki Ito and Kana Tosaoka are credited with character design. Naoki Endo composes the music.

The October 6 Japanese premiere, two-cour format, principal broadcast stations, domestic streaming rollout, KONAMI animation production and core staff are confirmed. International streaming remains the major detail still to be announced.

The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life premieres October 6, 2026 on Crunchyroll. Release date, studio and streaming details for Fall 2026.
The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life premieres October 6, 2026. Crunchyroll carries the series as part of its Fall 2026 lineup in supported international territories.

Rein is an Enchanter whose support magic strengthens weapons and armor. After his guild decides his work is no longer necessary and fires him, he recalls the enchantments he previously placed on their equipment and takes those accumulated bonus points back for himself.

That unusual mechanic transforms a discarded support character into someone with enormous potential. Rather than joining another elite party immediately, Rein begins again with basic clothes and a copper sword, turning the premise into a second-chance fantasy adventure.
Crunchyroll lists the anime for North America, Central and South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS and Southeast Asia. Exact release times can vary by region.
Crunchyroll released an official teaser in August ahead of the October premiere, introducing Rein's ability and the setup behind his new life.

Sasaki and Peeps Season 2 premieres October 7, 2026 on Crunchyroll. Release date, studio and streaming details for Fall 2026.
Sasaki and Peeps Season 2 is scheduled for October 7, 2026. The announced streaming platform is Crunchyroll.
Episode 1 premieres October 7 on Crunchyroll. The exact simulcast time is still TBA, so AniNextUp will add it only after an official announcement.

Sasaki’s supposedly ordinary life remains split between modern Japan and the fantasy world connected to Peeps. Season 2 continues the series’ mix of fantasy, supernatural incidents and workplace comedy rather than resetting the story for a new cast.

The official anime site published a new Season 2 visual and main promotional video in September, giving the sequel a fresh promotional campaign ahead of its October premiere. The animation studio remains SILVER LINK.
Crunchyroll has announced Season 2 for North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS, India and Southeast Asia. Availability can vary by local catalog.

The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 premieres October 7, 2026 on Crunchyroll. Release date, studio and streaming details for Fall 2026.
The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 is scheduled for October 7, 2026. The announced streaming platform is Crunchyroll.
Episode 1 premieres October 7 on Crunchyroll. The exact simulcast time is still TBA, so AniNextUp will add it only after an official announcement.

Season 2 continues Kimihiko Kimizuka’s story after the truth surrounding Siesta’s death has come into focus. The official introduction makes clear that the mystery is not treated as an ending: Kimihiko and the people around him still have to confront what it means to inherit the legendary detective’s will.

ENGI returns as the animation studio. Manabu Kurihara directs, Deko Akao handles series composition, and Yosuke Ito is credited for character design. The opening theme is “Kono Shinzō ni Hanataba o” by Koume, while Kagura Nana performs the ending theme “Hakuchūmu.”
Crunchyroll lists the season for North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS and Southeast Asia. The exact simulcast airtime remains TBA.

The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 premieres October 1, 2026 PT / October 2 JST on Netflix. Release date, studio and streaming details for Fall 2026.
Season 2 premieres worldwide on Netflix on October 1, 2026 PT / October 2 JST. Netflix has confirmed that new episodes will then arrive weekly rather than releasing the entire season at once.
The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 is a Netflix release. Because the global launch crosses time zones, Netflix describes the premiere as October 1 Pacific Time and October 2 in Japan.

The story continues the intertwined relationships of Koyuki Hikawa, Miki Azumi, Minato Amamiya and Yota Hino. Koyuki has difficulty opening up to other people, while the more outgoing Minato disrupts the emotional walls she has built around herself.
Netflix's Season 2 trailer focuses on the four friends as their feelings begin to shift and their relationships become harder to define, continuing the coming-of-age romance from the first season.
The anime adapts Kocha Agasawa's manga. Season 2 is also part of the broader Kocha Agasawa Anime Year project, alongside other adaptations of the creator's work.
A Returner's Magic Should Be Special Season 2 premieres October 7, 2026 on Crunchyroll.
Season 2 premieres October 7, 2026. Fuji TV schedules the first episode in its +Ultra block at 24:45 JST, equivalent to 12:45 a.m. on the following calendar day in standard time notation.

Crunchyroll streams Season 2 as part of its Fall 2026 simulcast lineup, with announced availability worldwide except Japan, China, Korea and Mongolia. Exact episode timing on the service can differ from the Japanese television slot.

Desir continues trying to prevent the catastrophic future he already experienced. After building a party with Romantica, Pram and Azest at Hebrion Academy, he faces a new Shadow World crisis while a nightmare involving Romantica and the destructive demon Dadaneuph points toward a larger threat.
Taishi Kawaguchi directs at Arvo Animation, with Takamitsu Kono handling series composition and scripts, Hiromi Kato on character design and Kenta Higashiohji composing the music.
FLOW performs the Season 2 opening song “Sorrow.” The band also performed the first season's opening, giving the continuation a musical connection to the original run.
Magic Knight Rayearth premieres October 7, 2026 as part of Crunchyroll's Fall 2026 lineup.
Magic Knight Rayearth premieres October 7, 2026 as part of Crunchyroll's Fall 2026 lineup.
The new Magic Knight Rayearth anime begins October 7, 2026. Crunchyroll lists it among its new Fall 2026 simulcasts, with E&H production handling animation.
The new production brings Hikaru, Umi and Fuu back in a retelling of the classic Magic Knight Rayearth story. E&H production is the animation studio.
The series starts October 7. AniNextUp will track weekly episode dates and update this guide when exact simulcast times are officially announced.
Crunchyroll lists availability across the Americas, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, parts of the CIS, Southeast Asia and Korea.
